name: get_comments
description: Get comments on a Figma file. If the URL is of the format https://figma.com/design/:fileKey/branch/:branchKey/:fileName then use the branchKey as the fileKey.

sessionId.description: After create_session succeeds, pass its exact returned UUID here on every file-tool call for this task, even when fileKey differs.

pageId.description: Filter comments to only those on this page.

userId.description: Filter comments to only those by this user ID.

mentionedUserId.description: Filter to comments that @mention this user ID.

unreadOnly.description: When true, return only unread comments for the authenticated user; false or omission leaves read status unfiltered. Applies to individual comments, including replies, and combines with the other filters. Does not mark comments as read.

resolved.description: If true, only return resolved comments. If false, only unresolved. If omitted, return both.

rootOnly.description: If true, only return root (thread-starting) comments, excluding replies.

threadId.description: Return only comments in this thread (the root comment and its replies).

limit.description: Maximum comments per page (1–50; default 20). Filters apply before pagination.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response (the nextCursor value). Pass this to fetch the next page of results.

nodeId.description: Return unresolved comment threads overlapping this canvas layer in Figma Design, FigJam, or Figma Slides, including replies. Cannot be combined with filters or pagination.

fileKey.description: The key of the Figma file to get comments from. Extract from a Figma URL: https://figma.com/design/:fileKey/:fileName
